title: Test and E2E databases start warm from a migrated template
description: A disposable cluster is a copy of one template cluster per schema digest, fsync off, holding a migrated template database. Two databases cloned from it are isolated and carry exactly the schema a cold migration builds; a new schema generation rebuilds the template and removes the stale one.

steps.name: Clone isolated current-schema databases from the warm template and rebuild it for a new generation
